## Notes

**Quick read:** Tattooed, high-energy mom of five who films a curly-haired toddler girl outdoors (park, woods, backyard with ponies) and in her living room; solid converter (ROAS 1.43, $1,926 GMV) and emotionally invested ("Bambora has been the best income yet on Trybe").
**Best next move:** send the working brief links and the first inspo batch Fatima promised on Sep 23, and in that batch steer her off "use your arms / dance" moments toward the wrist and arm relief angle.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: mom of five ("As a mom of five with a Velcro toddler"), long dark hair, arm and hand tattoos, sometimes glasses. Her toddler is a girl of roughly 15 to 20 months with curly hair; another older little girl appears on a swing in the Sep videos. Settings: a park playground, a wooded lawn, her backyard with a shed and ponies ("Let's go see the ponies!"), and a grey-sofa living room with an elephant print.
- Format: yapper talking to camera, loud and playful, lots of movement (spinning, dancing, scooping the toddler up). Burned-in karaoke captions in every video. Length 16 to 63 seconds. Newer ones (Sep 12 and Sep 22) are tighter: a wide opener outdoors, then close-ups of the buckle, safety strap and adjuster.
- Hooks: "I swear motherhood would be so much easier if I had two more arms, but I have the Bambora Sling instead", "If y'all have a toddler attached to the hip like I do, this is something that you need", "Does anyone else have a Velcro toddler?", "If you have a Velcro toddler and you need something to not make you lose your mind", text hook "If you don't have this for your baby or toddler... You're losing your sanity more than me."
- What worked: 1f18e6c7 (Aug 12, pony walk, mom of five) ran in 3 ads; 1f9f23de and 2141a802 in 2 ads each; 41baccca and 04bcc951 (back to school sale) 1 ad each. 61 purchases, $3,659 purchase value on $2,556 spend.
- Rejected: 9a5ff86d (Sep 12, "two more arms") because of a clip with both hands off the baby, "we no longer market ourselves as handsfree". She could not upload a revision (the video showed as rejected), so she resubmitted it as 62f623a0, approved Sep 22, not in ads yet.
- Safety and checklist: seat under the toddler's bottom and legs out looks right in the sheets. Recurring issues: hands off and hands-free framing. 41baccca (approved, in ads) shows her spinning with both arms flung out at 11s; 1f9f23de opens with arms spread; scripts say "so you can use your arms to do everything" (1f18e6c7) and "use your arms and dance and do whatever you want" (2141a802), both retired hands-free claims. Burned-in captions on every video (checklist 6). The Sep 22 caption misspells the brand as "Babora". The 2141a802 sheet only captured one frame (kitchen, buckle demo), so the rest of that video was not checked.
- Strengths: genuine chaos-of-five-kids energy, outdoor settings that look great, explains the safety strap clearly and states 10 to 50 pounds correctly.
- To improve: one hand on her toddler through every spin and scoop; swap "use your arms" for arm and back relief; skip burned-in captions and sale endings so ads stay evergreen.
